action.objective: Verify Qf3, the broad-search leader, at full depth; check whether Black's ...Bxh4/Kxg2 threats refute it.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search favors Qf3 (exact 158, PV ...Bxh4 Kd1 Qxf3 Nxf3). Black queen on g2 is a live threat and Qf3 may hang to Bxh4+; need single-candidate verification before committing.
